purpose: Independent merge-review follow-up: source-root normalization and real-model acceptance context isolation

path_fix.why: Upstream trim/normalize otherwise changed source identity or made the manifest prefix miss explicit roots
path_fix.behavior: Lexically normalize dot/repeated separators; reject original or normalized roots changed by ECMAScript trim before index writes; do not require source existence or resolve symlinks

acceptance_fix.why: The first real small-model run exposed baseline corpus directly in the initial raw context and an incomplete live-index usage description
acceptance_fix.behavior: Retain baseline raw corpus; bind actual subject profile; install existing NotesRollover retain_units=0; prepare and commit via PolicyRegistry; verify nonempty Pointer-only window and unchanged raw; uninstall before scenario input/inference
acceptance_fix.profile_helper: Normal S0 and pre-inference setup use one binding implementation; later profile changes still rebind normally
acceptance_fix.deployment_capacity: Required explicit SHENKO_OBELISK_ACCEPTANCE_CONTEXT_TOKENS; same value in both arms; reference to actual service metadata belongs to each model attempt
acceptance_fix.prompt: Complete scenario-independent live-index JSON examples; archive/live distinction; authentic later task_result and returned identifiers

focused_lint.limitation: Focused check, not the full CI baseline ratchet

independent_review.method: Read-only source and raw-evidence review; a missing local binding found during extraction was fixed before the recorded build
independent_review.scope: Profile/window preparation semantics and actual native capability description; no human approval claim

evidence_reuse.archive_and_store: Earlier executed evidence remains in ../2026-11-15-obelisk-validation.json; these implementation/test files did not change in the follow-up
evidence_reuse.path_runtime_and_native: Recorded on 1ff6725; 012370b changes model-facing description and context/sandbox setup, not these runtime/archive/lifecycle mechanisms

scenario_count.note: Repeated/model-varied executions reuse the single existing acceptance scenario; no extra test table or ignored test

limits: These engineering checks do not establish model efficacy
Each real-model attempt retains its own exact source, ELF, deployment and unmodified wire receipts
Latest pushed-head CI and final merge state must be read from PR #301; this record does not assert them
